items.title: Kacey Musgraves to Kristi Noem: "If you did you would have shot it"
items.summary: Kristi Noem posted "I'll take @ellalangleymsic over Kacey Musgraves any day" after Texas Senate candidate James Talarico joined Musgraves onstage in Dallas. Musgraves quoted her with "I don't think you have a dog in this fight but if you did you would have shot it," a reference to Noem writing that she shot her dog Cricket. The reply got 474K likes, about 43 times Noem's post, and was the most-liked post of the day. News of Breaking Bad star RJ Mitte's death at 34 broke the same day.
items.author: @KaceyMusgraves
